data.text: Full-day VR exposure is not recommended because it could induce cybersickness. Optimized navigation paths can be proposed using either an optimal path approach or an optimal path under a time constraint approach to maximize the user experience.
points: Full-day VR exposure is not recommended because it would induce cybersickness.
The optimal path approach may still lead to cybersickness in large virtual worlds.
The optimal path under a time constraint approach maximizes the number of important points visited within a time threshold.
Optimized navigation paths can be proposed using either approach to maximize the user experience.

data.text: The Satra campus is modeled as a graph of points of interest, with data gathered through an iterative process of field studies and interviews. Points of interest are defined as specific locations, such as lake corners, rather than entire physical objects. Navigation can be optimized using a TSP solver for a minimum-time path or a VRPP solver to maximize important points while accounting for relative importance and maximum wait times.
points: The Satra campus is modeled as a graph where points of interest are nodes weighted by Euclidean distance.
Graph data is collected through an iterative process involving field studies, observations, and interviews.
Points of interest refer to specific locations, such as lake corners, rather than entire physical objects.
Navigation can be optimized using a TSP solver for a minimum-time path or a VRPP solver to maximize important points while accounting for relative importance and maximum wait times.
